bib.title: Chapter 6: Building the Summarizer Agent for Context Reduction (Context Engineering for Multi-Agent Systems)

question: How can a multi-agent context engine proactively reduce context size and API cost by adding a specialist Summarizer agent without redesigning the core engine?
contributions: A Summarizer agent (agent_summarizer) that reduces text to a summary under a caller-supplied summary_objective
Registry and capability-description update so the Planner discovers the agent dynamically
A Writer agent upgrade accepting both {'facts':...} and {'summary':...} inputs
A single worked demonstration with token counts and a business-value framing

results.claim: In the Juno demo the Summarizer cut the Writer's input from 253 to 110 tokens, a 56.5% reduction (single example, count_tokens with tiktoken).
results.setup: One dense paragraph about the Juno probe, gpt-5 as generation model, Summarizer then Librarian then Writer plan; tokens counted with count_tokens (tiktoken, gpt-4 encoding, cl100k_base fallback).
results.quote: The Summarizer agent achieved a 56.5% reduction in token count.
results.note: Original 253 tokens, summary 110 tokens; (1-110/253)=56.5%. One run, LLM output is stochastic (chapter notes this).
results.where: Step 1: Summarizer agent takes the lead

results.claim: Original text length in the demo.
Hypothetical business case: 10,000 reports per day with over 50% token cut on the final generation step could save thousands to tens of thousands of dollars per month in API cost.
results.setup: Hypothetical financial-services firm; no pricing, token sizes or measurement given.
results.note: No arithmetic shown; the 50% figure is an assumption.
results.where: Translating technical efficiency into business value

results.claim: Adding the Summarizer broke the Writer because Researcher emits {'facts'} and Summarizer emits {'summary'}; the Writer was patched to check both keys.
results.setup: Initial testing of the Planner chaining Summarizer output into Writer.
results.quote: When it received a dictionary with a 'summary' key instead of a 'facts' key, it failed.

results.claim: Smaller, focused context is asserted to give faster generation and higher-quality output (no measurement).
results.where: Translating technical efficiency into business value

limits: Single example (one 253-token paragraph, one run); no quality evaluation of summaries, no faithfulness check, no latency or dollar measurement.
Cost and speed benefits and quality gain are asserted, not measured.
Planner reliably choosing the Summarizer is shown for one goal only; backward-compatibility tests are promised but results are not shown.
The Summarizer is not applied automatically on a token threshold; count_tokens is used only in post-hoc analysis.
Prompt texts (system prompt, user prompt, goal) are truncated in the PDF text.
practices: Write a specific summary_objective (entities, figures, constraints, output form) rather than 'Summarize this text'; this is micro-context engineering (Micro-context engineering).
Measure token cost with count_tokens before sending text to an LLM, as the basis for proactive context management (Foundation for cost management).
Place the Summarizer upstream of the most expensive generation agent so it receives the reduced text (Step 3).
Register new agents and describe inputs/outputs in get_capabilities_description so the Planner discovers them without hardcoding.
Validate agent inputs and wrap in try/except; return predictable MCP messages with a stable key ('summary').
Keep data contracts compatible across agents; make consumers accept all producer output shapes (Reinforcing the Writer agent).
Run backward-compatibility tests after adding capabilities.
Trace each step (ExecutionTrace, resolved_context) to audit what each agent received.

terms.definition: the engine can now analyze, measure, and condense information instead of simply processing whatever it is given
a system deliberately designed for transparency and control, with every action traceable through an ExecutionTrace
the skill of turning a generic, multi-purpose tool into a specialized, high-precision instrument via a precise summary_objective
replacing placeholders such as $$STEP_1_OUTPUT$$ with actual outputs from previous steps
